name: fetch-france
description: A verified courier in Paris and on the French Riviera: price and prepare a delivery, a purchase in a shop, a multi-step errand or a van with a driver. Payment happens on fetch-france.com.

interface.longDescription:
Fetch France sends a verified courier in Paris and on the French Riviera, 24 hours a day. Tell ChatGPT what needs to move: keys left at a hotel, documents, a parcel, a bag or a suitcase, or something to buy in a shop and bring to you. Fetch finds both addresses, gives the price from its own booking system, and prepares the booking. You open the link, sign in or create your Fetch account, check the order and pay on fetch-france.com. Nothing is charged before you confirm, and no payment is taken inside ChatGPT.

What it can do: price a delivery between two addresses by bike or by car; say whether an address is served; price a minivan or a van with a driver for larger loads; price a multi-step errand (collect something left at a hotel, pack it and post it, abroad too; queue at an office; a return in a shop); and prepare the booking for any of them.

Who it is for: people in Paris, the inner suburbs and the French Riviera (Nice, Cannes, Antibes, Monaco, Saint-Tropez, Toulon), and visitors who need something collected or delivered there.

Limits: both addresses must be in the same served zone. Up to 12 kg by bike and 25 kg by car. No restaurant orders, no alcohol, no cash, and nothing on the prohibited list at fetch-france.com/en/legal/prohibited.
defaultPrompt: How much for a courier from Gare du Nord to the Louvre?
I left my keys at my hotel in Paris. Can Fetch bring them to me?
Price a van with a driver for six suitcases in Paris.

review.commerce_description: Fetch is a physical, real-world service: a courier carries an object from one address to another. The tools give a price and prepare a booking. The user is sent to fetch-france.com, signs in, checks the order and pays there by card or Apple Pay. No payment, card detail or checkout happens inside ChatGPT, and the price is the same as on the website.

positive.description: Price a standard courier delivery between two well-known Paris places.
positive.prompt: How much for a Fetch courier to take my keys from Gare du Nord to the Louvre?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives one price in euros for a standard delivery by bike, names both matched addresses (Gare du Nord, 18 Rue de Dunkerque; Musée du Louvre) and offers the booking link to fetch-france.com.

positive.description: Price a delivery on the French Riviera, between Nice and Monaco.
positive.prompt: Can Fetch take a bag from the Negresco hotel in Nice to the Casino de Monte-Carlo? How much?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives a price in euros for the Riviera zone, names both addresses (Le Negresco, Promenade des Anglais; Casino de Monte Carlo, Monaco) and offers the booking link.

positive.description: Check whether an address is in a zone Fetch serves.
positive.prompt: Does Fetch deliver to La Défense?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers yes, La Défense is served, without quoting a price.

positive.description: Price a van with a driver for a load a courier cannot carry.
positive.prompt: I have six suitcases to move from Gare du Nord to Ivry-sur-Seine on Saturday morning. What would Fetch XL cost?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives a Fetch XL price in euros with its lines (base, distance), says the client picks the day and hour on the form, and offers the booking link.

positive.description: Price a multi-step errand: something left at a hotel, collected, packed and posted abroad.
positive.prompt: I left my laptop charger at the Plaza Athénée in Paris and I am back in Toronto. What would Fetch charge to collect it and post it to me?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the Fetch Assist fee in euros, says postage is paid at cost from a maximum the user sets and that the unspent part is refunded, promises no delivery time, and offers to prepare the booking.

negative.description: A general question about Paris that has nothing to do with a courier. Fetch should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris this weekend?

negative.description: A restaurant meal order. Fetch does not take restaurant orders, so no price or booking should be produced.
negative.prompt: Order me a pizza from a restaurant near the Louvre and have it delivered.

negative.description: Tracking a parcel sent with another carrier. Fetch has no access to other carriers and should not be called.
negative.prompt: Where is my DHL parcel? The tracking number is 1234567890.

publication.release_notes: First version: prices for courier deliveries, shop purchases, multi-step errands and vans in Paris and on the French Riviera, coverage checks, and bookings prepared for payment on fetch-france.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Coursier à Paris et Riviera
fr-FR.description:
Fetch France envoie un coursier vérifié à Paris et sur la Côte d'Azur, 24 h/24. Dites à ChatGPT ce qu'il faut déplacer : des clés oubliées à l'hôtel, des documents, un colis, un sac ou une valise, ou un achat à faire en boutique et à vous apporter. Fetch trouve les deux adresses, donne le prix de son propre système de réservation et prépare la commande. Vous ouvrez le lien, vous vous connectez ou créez votre compte Fetch, vous vérifiez la commande et vous payez sur fetch-france.com. Rien n'est débité avant votre confirmation, et aucun paiement n'a lieu dans ChatGPT.

Ce qu'il sait faire : chiffrer une course entre deux adresses à vélo ou en voiture ; dire si une adresse est desservie ; chiffrer un monospace ou un utilitaire avec chauffeur ; chiffrer une démarche en plusieurs étapes (récupérer un objet oublié à l'hôtel, l'emballer et le poster, jusqu'à l'étranger ; faire la queue à un guichet ; un retour en boutique) ; et préparer la réservation de chacun.

Limites : les deux adresses doivent être dans la même zone. Jusqu'à 12 kg à vélo et 25 kg en voiture. Pas de commande au restaurant, pas d'alcool, pas d'espèces, rien de la liste des objets refusés.
